official_web_observations.scope: read-only protocol observations: state cursors, pagination, updates, forward rnd, communication families; no copied implementation
read-only API6 authentication/crypto behavior comparison; no copied implementation

evidence.scope: synthetic API6 crypto/auth/RPC/socket/recovery/media and communication-family fixtures; normal/race tests
evidence.capacity: 100 distinct synthetic account credentials; 200 handshakes, 400 RPCs, 200 socket events, 200 checkpoint commits, max concurrency permits 4; two connection cycles. Not live-account or sustained capacity.

final_targeted_gates.scope: synthetic native providers and durable storage, including distinct Eitaa classic-chat and channel-backed supergroup namespaces; not live provider verification

limitations: No live Rubika personal-account result is recorded.
Recovery persists provider account and peer state, with explicit OldState/baseline gaps; initial historical import and exhaustive recovery completeness are not claimed.
No reviewed current closePoll/stopPoll method was found; poll.close remains unavailable.
Voice is verified Ogg Opus, audio is Ogg Opus and video is inspected unfragmented AVC MP4; arbitrary codecs/transcoding are not implemented.
Unknown sends remain unknown; socket events and matching message content are not acknowledgement proofs.
Inventories list wrappers and protocol methods separately; neither row count nor route count is a compatibility percentage.

The reviewed Web client uses update.timestamp as UI trackBy, without a witnessed monotonic ordering comparison. Conflicting attachment edits with no proven revision order withhold download_supported instead of exposing stale bytes; new references remain available.

Dedicated read receipts are not emitted. Reviewed chat state has last_seen_my_mid / last_seen_peer_mid watermarks; only last_seen_my_mid is currently retained by native chat-state projection. No per-message reader or read timestamp is inferred.

incoming_updates.evidence: Encrypted socket and getMessagesUpdates fixtures; exact object GUID and message identity, provider edit/delete timestamp retained, no reconciliation proof inferred.
Finite chat-state projections and provider state/checkpoint CAS; observed timestamps are labeled.

The reviewed Web bundle merges chat_updates and compares chat.last_seen_my_mid / last_seen_peer_mid against message IDs. Native chat-state projection currently retains last_seen_my_mid only; it does not emit per-message or peer-read receipt events. A dedicated receipt contract needs explicit cumulative-watermark semantics, replay identity and a decision on group reader coverage; no standalone read_updates/seen_updates stream was found in this bundle. This is a receive-contract limitation, not proof that receipt support is impossible.
No full receive-family claim. Unrecognized frames are surfaced as unsupported coverage diagnostics, independently of provider-expired recovery states; private raw provider objects are not forwarded.

passed: native SMS sign-in and device registration
self text, idempotent replay, edit and forward

file send and byte-identical download after history registration

web voice playback control reached the synthetic 0.6-second duration
service chat.info and history: three reviewed text messages
post-fix self send and browser-origin self message -> durable event -> signed webhook; legacy warning separated from gap

password, logout, outage recovery, group/channel administration and other operation variants remain live-unverified
